heading: Tuesday
text: Morning rain and fog then clearing, becoming sunny east then clouds spreading over NY & the St. Lawrence Valley in the evening. Highs in through the 70s north to south, low 80s southeast. Northwest winds up to 10 mph.

heading: TuesdayNight
text: High clouds with periods of sky, becoming mostly cloudy north, partly south. Chance of late north. Lows in the low to mid 50s, upper 40s northeast. Southerly breeze over Lake Champlain, overwise calm.

heading: Wednesday
text: Mostly cloudy. Spotty morning shower north. Showers increasing through NY and the St. Lawrence, spreading east, mainly from the Adirondacks at Rt. 4 north. Highs in the 70s north to south, some upper 60s. Becoming breezy. Winds south 10 to 15 mph east of the Green Mountains, and 10 to 20 mph, gusting to 30 mph from the Green Mountains west.
